_comment: Settings for the GTFS feed gtfs_feed.py builds (/gtfs.zip). routes: one GTFS route per line riders know, made of the TransLoc RouteIDs that run it (Gold's daytime and post-6PM patterns are one line). Routes not listed (Charter, Training, test routes, game-day lot shuttles) are left out. purple: which TransLoc pattern Purple runs in each part of the day (local seconds after midnight); its headways are config/purple_headways.json. stop_names: fixes for TransLoc stop names, by physical stop id (AddressID). headsigns: what a trip heading to a timestop says.

headsign_zones._comment: {TransLoc route id: [[stop_id, headsign], ...]}: the headsign is the next major area the bus is heading to. Each entry starts at that stop (physical stop_id, in the route's loop order) and runs until the next entry, wrapping round the loop. stop_headsign comes from this; a trip's trip_headsign is the zone of its first stop. Place names follow the bus destination signs, spelled out; the hospital is always 'UVA Hospital' (user, 2026-10-20). Routes not listed fall back to 'headsigns' below. 6 Runk Dining Hall, 102 Chemistry Building, 156 Barracks Road Shopping Center, 30 Contemplative Commons, 66 Shannon Library, 74 UVA Chapel, 113 Madison & Preston, 79 JPA @ West Complex, 11 Carl Smith Way @ Scott Stadium, 55 Pinn Hall, 26 JPJ South Lot, 47 George Welsh Way @ Scott Stadium, 5 Lee St @ UVA Medical Center, 188 Fontaine.

timestop_overrides._comment: {TransLoc route id: {sheet timestop code: RouteStopID}}: where the feed puts a sheet's timestop on that route. Gold blocks the sheet starts at CSW (Scott Stadium: [09] 05:00, [12] 07:30, [10] 08:30) really start at McCormick Rd @ Chemistry Building, part of a long-term detour the sheet never got (user, 2026-10-20). 879 = Chemistry on daytime Gold (67).

occupancy._comment: GTFS-RT crowding label per bus, keyed by the capacity TransLoc reports for it (GetVehicleCapacities). steps: [riders at least, label], the last one reached wins. 18 = the 24xxx buses: 12 seats, 18 is a hard limit. 50 = everything else: 31 seats, 50 is a rough rating, 60-65 get crammed in (user, 2026-10-20). occupancy_percentage is riders / TransLoc capacity and may pass 100.
